text: Rows of jars dimmed as though a cloud had passed before an unseen sun. Several figures stopped in the middle of their repeated motions. A man with both hands raised toward his face held perfectly still; a child reaching for a suspended bead froze with one heel lifted from the jar's floor. Their labels remained for another breath, then the carved letters began to flatten.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun released Zik long enough to snatch Enhedu's figurine from the desk and thrust it into her pocket. The floor shifted beneath her boots. Not enough to throw her, but enough to alter the angle of the room. The farthest aisle now sloped upward where it had been level. A shelf she remembered against the eastern wall stood several paces nearer, though no track marked its passage through the dust.
speaker: Narrator

text: His left sleeve collapsed at the wrist.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun stared. The cloth lay flat against the desk where his forearm should have supported it. The calcified key remained pressed to the Ledger, but nothing visible connected it to his elbow. She grabbed the sleeve and felt along its length.
speaker: Narrator

text: She pulled the cuff back. The fabric ended around emptiness. No wound opened beneath it. No blood marked the cloth. His body continued from shoulder to elbow, and then the shape simply ceased, as though the missing portion had never been included.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik looked once. Whatever he saw stripped the color from his face.

text: A second line formed across the page. Ninsun caught fragments as the ink settled: OUTWARD, RECORD, something that might have been RETURN before a stroke crossed through it and turned it into another word. Zik's hand moved with less resistance now. The muscles of his right arm still strained, but the quill had found a rhythm his body could not interrupt.

text: Ninsun reached around his waist and pulled with all the force she had left. For a heartbeat he came away from the desk. The quill dragged a jagged stroke across the paper.

text: Every jar in the chamber turned toward them.

text: The figures inside did not rotate their heads. The jars themselves changed position on the shelves until their labels faced the desk and the trapped subjects faced outward. Hundreds of miniature faces looked through the glass.
